title: Phase 5a: durable harness_turns + live-events hub (multi-replica BFF)
description: HarnessTurnRegistry and threadLiveEvents are in-process. Add durable harness_turns (Postgres/Redis) or sticky thread_id routing. Kill one BFF replica mid-turn; SSE still streams. Plan §4.3.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Kill one BFF replica mid-turn; SSE still streams
- [ ] Registry survives restart
- [ ] Cancel still finds turn_id
notes:
Playbook: feature.md
architect skipped: plan 0019 §4.3/§9 5a already locked durable harness_turns (Postgres/Redis) or sticky thread_id routing. Two shapes: (A) Postgres harness_turns + LISTEN/NOTIFY live-events hub on CONTROL_PLANE_DATABASE_URL (same DB as .3 inbound queue) (B) ALB sticky thread_id + in-process maps. Picked A because sticky fails registry-survives-restart and cancel-on-other-replica; Redis would add a second infra path CI often skips.

Throughput checkpoint:
- Blocking first steps: typed durable turn rows + claim lease (unclaimed | streaming+TTL | completed) before SSE/cancel wiring
- Independent workstreams: n/a — registry + hub + thin app.ts await is one leaf (.7 owns stall watchdog)
- Shared mutable state: turn claim lease is the structural serializer so two replicas do not double-stream; LISTEN fan-out so they do not share in-process Maps (principle-separate-before-serializing-shared-state)
- Smallest safe decomposition: one worker; in-memory registry stays default for tests; pg when CONTROL_PLANE_DATABASE_URL is set (index.ts), matching inbound-queue lazy inject

Heartbeat is owned by the pg registry (ttl/3) so a live claim does not expire; process death drops timers and the lease becomes stealable.
Pushed fcd75ed6. Draft PR https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/697. Not closed; merge stage after QA/CI.
Evidence: harness-turns-live-events-pg.test.ts (6) plus chat-delivery-events, inbound-queue, inbound-spine-send, chat-delivery, chat-harness.integration, mailbox-halt, chat-harness-swallowed, mention-hop-retired (68 total). tsc --noEmit clean.
close_reason: Merged https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/697 — durable Postgres harness_turns + LISTEN/NOTIFY live-events hub; registry survives restart; cancel finds turn_id on replica B; replica B can steal claim lease if replica A dies mid-turn.
